verdict_reason: K2.2's 1.29x does not survive a fair same-session CPU baseline. Warmed dense pp512 is 1.12x (2B) / 1.15x (4B second-rep). Hybrid CalaQwen projects 1.07x. Boundaries are ~0.07 ms/tok (not the killer). 4B average 1.55x is the cold-mmap first-rep (14.98 vs 30.89 t/s) — same trap as K2.2's 63.6 CPU average (82 then 45).

m1.note: F32 activations: clEnqueueWrite/ReadBuffer CL_TRUE, no convert kernel in ggml-opencl

k22_published_p128.note: CPU second-rep thermal/mmap drop created the 1.29x

hybrid.approximation: t_hybrid = t_cpu * f_expert + t_cpu * (1-f_expert) / s_attn + t_bound. s_attn = 2B pp512 GPU/CPU (same GDN family, n_embd=2048). Expert FFN stays CPU (Q7-LANDMINE). True hybrid layer not wired — this is the spec-allowed approximation.

energy_screening.method: termux-battery-status current (uA) * voltage, point samples not integral
energy_screening.note: SCREENING only. No idle subtraction, no p95 soak. Not a K-E confirmatory protocol.
